title: Stable namespaced identifiers
description: Canonical entity-identifier grammar: a lowercase type prefix (2-24 characters), one underscore, and a 26-character Crockford base32 body (ULID alphabet, uppercase, excluding I, L, O, and U). Matches the specification's identifier style (for example clm_…, ev_…, fld_…) while keeping bodies lexicographically sortable and free of visually ambiguous characters. Identifiers are opaque: no component may parse meaning out of the body.

idPrefix.title: Identifier type prefix
idPrefix.description: Lowercase alphanumeric type prefix starting with a letter; 2-24 characters. The prefix names the entity kind and is assigned by the owning contract.
